title: Sunday - Ziyarat of Lady Fatimah Zahra (s)
categoryChain: Sunday - Ziyarat of Lady Fatimah Zahra (s)
introduction:
ZIYARAH OF LADY FATIMAH AL ZAHRA (S) ON SUNDAYS

Another Ziyarah According To Another Narration

verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O examined lady
He Who created you has examined you
and found that you have passed the examination patiently.
I am a believer of you

verses.arabic: صَابِرٌ عَلٰى مَا اَتٰى بِهِ اَبُوْكِ وَ وَصِيُّهُ
verses.translation: and I am carrying out that with which your father and his successor has come patiently;
peace be upon both of them.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا اَسْاَلُكِ اِنْ كُنْتُ صَدَّقْتُكِ
verses.translation: I now beseech you by my belief in you
to add me up with my belief in both of them
so that I will be delighted.
So, testify to me that I am totally loyal to you
and to your Household;
peace of Allah be upon them all.
Peace be upon you, O examined lady.

verses.arabic: امْتَحَنَكِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكِ قَبْلَ اَنْ يَخْلُقَكِ
verses.translation: He Who created you had examined you before He created you.

verses.arabic: وَ كُنْتِ لِمَا امْتَحَنَكِ بِهِ صَابِرَةً
verses.translation: So, you passed the examination patiently.
We are loyal to and believers in you

verses.arabic: وَ لِكُلِّ مَا اَتٰى بِهِ اَبُوْكِ
verses.translation: and to all that which has been conveyed [to us] by your father,

verses.arabic: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ
verses.translation: may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him,

verses.arabic: وَ اَتٰى بِهِ وَصِيُّهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ مُسَلِّمُوْنَ
verses.translation: and to that which his successor ('a) has carried to us, are submissive.
So, we beseech You, O Allah,
in the name of our belief in them,
to add us, due to our belief, to the sublime rank

verses.arabic: لِنُبَشِّرَ اَنْفُسَنَا بِاَنَّا قَدْ طَهُرْنَا بِوِلَايَتِهِمْ [بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ‏]
verses.translation: so that we will enjoy the good tidings that we have been purified on account of our loyalty to them,
peace be upon them.
